FILED s473w (Opus, 2026-09-09) from the #1502 CPAN-board census. This is the board's LARGEST remaining cluster: 55 of the 375 failing rows. Text::Balanced's `extract_quotelike` and `extract_tagged` return UNDEF (and leave `pos` at 0) for inputs real perl extracts. The dist's own t-files then fail their `substr($str, pos($str)||0, 1) eq ';'` assertion with `'s'` / `' '` where perl gives `';'`, and the scalar-context row with the whole untouched string where perl gives the extracted text.
